The '''HpT10''' was a efficient [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift engine]] manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] and mounted in the standard models of the [[D-22 "Screamer" speeder bike|D-22 "Screamer"]], a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SoF" />
